Question B-001-024-004.

Why the correct answer is right: The exposure limit is lowest in the 48 MHz to 300 MHz range because the human body absorbs radio-frequency (RF) energy most in that range. Lower allowed exposure corresponds to greater absorption concern.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "There are more transmitters operating in this range": The number of transmitters is not the reason given for the lower exposure limit.
- sourceIndex 2: "There are fewer transmitters operating in this range": Fewer transmitters would not explain a more restrictive human-exposure limit; stronger human-body absorption does.
- sourceIndex 3: "Most transmissions in this range are for a longer time": Transmission duration is separate from the reason for the lower limit; body absorption is the reason.
